name: Elizabeth Saskia
source:
Captain of the Karate Club. Elizabeth or as Shuyaku calls her Liz. Is a girl who fights for what she believes in... literally. One day a group of thugs beat up one of her club members and stole a bag of shinais without asking for it.

So what does she do she challenges them all to a fight in the courtyard. Typical courtyard fight. And that is how she met Shuyaku. She happened to be sitting in the place he likes to sit in in the courtyard. Shuyaku sees her as very similar to himself so he decides to help her with these thugs.
